title.zh: 【Babylon Labs 在 Aave 社区发布添加原生比特币作为 v4 抵押品的提案】
title.en: 【Babylon Labs 在 Aave 社区发布添加原生比特币作为 v4 抵押品的提案】

current_state.zh: Babylon Labs submitted an ARFC proposal to Aave governance to list native BTC as collateral in Aave V4 via Trustless Bitcoin Vaults, deploying Babylon Spoke and BTC Vault Swap Spoke with BTC locked through Taproot UTXOs and redemption secured by on-chain rules and zero-knowledge proofs.
current_state.en: Babylon Labs submitted an ARFC proposal to Aave governance to list native BTC as collateral in Aave V4 via Trustless Bitcoin Vaults, deploying Babylon Spoke and BTC Vault Swap Spoke with BTC locked through Taproot UTXOs and redemption secured by on-chain rules and zero-knowledge proofs.
